_README: This is Round 2 ("Double Jeopardy") of the Template Game — see the _README block at the top of sample-game.json for the full format guide and how multi-round games work. The only real difference here: same shape (5-6 categories, 5 clues each), but every value is DOUBLED — 400/800/1200/1600/2000 instead of 200/400/600/800/1000 — and the clues should be a notch harder.
name: Template Game — Round 2 (Double Jeopardy)

clues.question: This is the longest river in the world.
This country is both the largest by area and spans 11 time zones.
This mountain range separates Europe from Asia.
This African desert is the largest hot desert in the world.
This landlocked sea is technically the largest lake on Earth.
This document was signed in 1215, limiting the power of the English king.
This wall dividing a European capital fell in 1989.
This ancient wonder of the world was a lighthouse in Egypt.
clues.answer: What is the Lighthouse of Alexandria?

clues.question: This 1969 event put the first humans on the Moon.
This treaty formally ended World War I in 1919.
clues.answer: What is the Treaty of Versailles?
